'''Open (no shields / no v-cards)''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] (code <code>open_no_shields_no_virtual</code>). Its card pool is Decipher-printed set ids 1&ndash;14 ([[Premiere]] through [[Theed Palace]]) and premium ids 101&ndash;112, with no virtual cards, and every card with the Defensive Shield icon is banned.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="sets" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />
